source: Publisher documentation saved under e3/truth/docs/fresh/ (sha256 in SHA256SUMS): TPC-DS v3.2.0; LDBC SNB specification (v2.2.5-SNAPSHOT, Appendix D for the Interactive v1 legacy data sets); GTFS Schedule Reference; FAA ardata.pdf (5/8/2025); ABS ASGS Edition 3 web pages; SEC Financial Statement Data Sets; College Scorecard Field of Study documentation (October 2026) and data dictionary; EPA AirData FileFormats (v3.0.0); 2024 ACS PUMS data dictionary and Census regions and divisions; City of Chicago portal metadata (ijzp-q8t2, c7ck-438e); USDA FoodData Central download field descriptions (October 2020)
rule: Sigma* is the set of FDs that the publisher documentation implies among the attributes of each relation, projected and closed over the dropped columns, each with a verbatim quote; sure when the quoted text states it (declared key, foreign key to a declared key, an explicit one-to-one or nesting statement), unsure when it needs an inference the text does not spell out. Dependencies the documentation hints at but does not state are listed under undocumented_regularities and are not part of Sigma*. Written from the documentation alone, before any data file was opened.

instance.generator: public data fixed before download for the confirmatory evaluation, joined by fresh.py
instance.construction: ACS 2024 1-year PUMS person file for California (psam_p06.csv); single table; dropped RT, STATE, DIVISION, REGION and ADJINC (constant in a one-state, one-year file: STATE 06, DIVISION 9 Pacific and REGION 4 West per census_us_regdiv.pdf 'California (06)' under 'Division 9: Pacific' and 'Region 4: West', and the single '2024 factor (1.015250)'), the replicate weights PWGTP1-80, the allocation flags and the other person variables, keeping the recodes the dictionary relates to another kept variable.

cleaning.missing_values: empty and missing references become '?', kept as a value (null = null)

truth.clause: pums_PUMS_Data_Dictionary_2024.txt (2024 ACS PUMS Data Dictionary, October 16, 2025), PERSON RECORD-BASIC VARIABLES: SERIALNO "Housing unit/GQ person serial number" with "2024HU0000001..2024HU9999999 .HU Unique identifier"; SPORDER "Person number" with "01..20 .Person number"
truth.justification: A person record is the person numbered SPORDER within the housing unit or group-quarters person identified by SERIALNO.

audit.quote: SERIALNO "Housing unit/GQ person serial number" with "2024GQ0000001..2024GQ9999999 .GQ Unique identifier" and "2024HU0000001..2024HU9999999 .HU Unique identifier"; SPORDER "Person number" with "01..20 .Person number"
audit.source: pums_PUMS_Data_Dictionary_2024.txt (2024 ACS PUMS Data Dictionary, October 16, 2025), PERSON RECORD-BASIC VARIABLES

truth.clause: pums_PUMS_Data_Dictionary_2024.txt (2024 ACS PUMS Data Dictionary, October 16, 2025), HOUSING RECORD-BASIC VARIABLES: SERIALNO "Housing unit/GQ person serial number" ("HU Unique identifier") and PUMA "Public use microdata area code (PUMA) based on 2020 Census definition (areas with population of 100,000 or more, use with STATE for unique code)"
truth.justification: PUMA is a basic variable of the housing record identified by SERIALNO and is repeated on its person records; within the one-state file STATE is constant, so PUMA alone is the area.

audit.quote: HOUSING RECORD-BASIC VARIABLES: SERIALNO "Housing unit/GQ person serial number" ("2024HU0000001..2024HU9999999 .HU Unique identifier") and PUMA "Public use microdata area code (PUMA) based on 2020 Census definition (areas with population of 100,000 or more, use with STATE for unique code)"; the same SERIALNO and PUMA are listed under PERSON RECORD-BASIC VARIABLES
audit.source: pums_PUMS_Data_Dictionary_2024.txt (2024 ACS PUMS Data Dictionary, October 16, 2025), HOUSING RECORD-BASIC VARIABLES; PERSON RECORD-BASIC VARIABLES

truth.clause: pums_PUMS_Data_Dictionary_2024.txt (2024 ACS PUMS Data Dictionary, October 16, 2025), WAOB "World area of birth": "US state (POBP = 001-059)", "Europe (POBP = 100-157,160,162-199)", "Africa (POBP = 400-499)" (every category defined by POBP ranges)
truth.justification: Each WAOB category is defined as a set of POBP codes, so the place of birth determines the world area of birth.

audit.quote: WAOB "World area of birth": "1 .US state (POBP = 001-059)", "2 .PR and US Island Areas (POBP = 061-099)", "3 .Latin America (POBP = 303,310-399)", "4 .Asia (POBP = 158-159,161,200-299)", "5 .Europe (POBP = 100-157,160,162-199)", "6 .Africa (POBP = 400-499)", "7 .Northern America (POBP = 300-302,304-309)", "8 .Oceania and at Sea (POBP = 060,500-554)"

truth.clause: pums_PUMS_Data_Dictionary_2024.txt (2024 ACS PUMS Data Dictionary, October 16, 2025): YOEP "Year of entry" (e.g. "1939 - 1944", "1950") and DECADE "Decade of entry" (e.g. "Before 1950", "1950 - 1959"; "N/A (Born in the US)")
truth.justification: Both describe the same entry; the decade follows from the year by the label ranges, but the dictionary does not state that DECADE is recoded from YOEP; unsure.

audit.quote: YOEP "Year of entry": "bbbb .N/A (Not eligible - Born in the US)", "1938 .1938 or earlier (Bottom-coded)", "1939 .1939 - 1944", "1945 .1945", ..., "2024 .2024"; DECADE "Decade of entry": "b .N/A (Born in the US)", "1 .Before 1950", "2 .1950 - 1959", "3 .1960 - 1969", ..., "8 .2010 or later"
audit.source: pums_PUMS_Data_Dictionary_2024.txt (2024 ACS PUMS Data Dictionary, October 16, 2025), PERSON RECORD-PERSON VARIABLES (YOEP); PERSON RECORD-RECODED PERSON VARIABLES (DECADE)

truth.clause: pums_PUMS_Data_Dictionary_2024.txt (2024 ACS PUMS Data Dictionary, October 16, 2025): MSP "Married, spouse present/spouse absent" (e.g. "Now married, spouse present", "N/A (age less than 15 years)") and MAR "Marital status" (e.g. "Married", "Never married or under 15 years old")
truth.justification: Every MSP category falls into one MAR category by its label, but the dictionary does not state that MSP refines MAR; unsure.

audit.quote: MSP "Married, spouse present/spouse absent": "b .N/A (age less than 15 years)", "1 .Now married, spouse present", "2 .Now married, spouse absent", "3 .Widowed", "4 .Divorced", "5 .Separated", "6 .Never married"; MAR "Marital status": "1 .Married", "2 .Widowed", "3 .Divorced", "4 .Separated", "5 .Never married or under 15 years old"

truth.justification: Native versus foreign born follows from the citizenship categories under the Census definition of nativity, which the dictionary does not give; unsure.

audit.quote: CIT "Citizenship status": "2 .Born in Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, or Northern Marianas", "3 .Born abroad of U.S. citizen parent or parents"; NATIVITY "Nativity": "1 .Native", "2 .Foreign born"
